_comment: Versioned theater lighting presets. Energies are absolute Watts per light GROUP (see group_prefixes in lighting_presets.py for the name->group mapping). baseline_reference records the blend's authored energies so multiplier-derived presets are traceable. Applied identically by preview_render.py and bake_lightmaps.py.

movie_mode.description: Dark theater with the movie screen dominant. Derived 2026-07-10 as house 0.15x, screen 1.5x of baseline.
